agent_explanation: Single body with large radius 1.13 moving right at 8.88 m/s under gravity. At step 65 it is inside arena (overshoot negative), by step 68 it is at edge (overshoot 0.126), at step 69 it exceeds tolerance (x 19.049 + r 1.13 = 20.179, overshoot 0.1795 > 0.15). The arena boundary collision/positional correction fails to contain the body when displacement per substep remains large, allowing centre+radius to leave arena.
